CustomField.description: The AIWorkflowAction__c the model suggested in this reply, if any - parsed by AIAgentManager out of a trailing structured block in the model's own response. Never executed automatically; the chat UI reads this to offer a button, and the Workflow Action itself only ever runs when the user explicitly triggers it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set only when the model's reply suggests running a Workflow Action. The action still requires explicit user confirmation to run.
CustomField.label: Suggested Workflow Action Id
